## Appearance

Anne Shirley has big, scornful gray eyes, a little pointed chin, and an awfully nice nose set in a sweet, white face. Her cheeks are faintly flushed with pink, and her bright hair, which was once turned green, is seen streaming behind her unbraided in a torrent of brightness.

## Personality

A talkative and highly imaginative child, she possesses a vivid imagination that frequently defines her outlook. Though sometimes noted as careless and reckless, she maintains an optimistic mindset, recognizing that bad outcomes often turn out better than expected. She is generous in spirit and demonstrates a sense of responsibility by being willing to confess her mistakes. Her desires include staying at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), growing up to be good-looking, attending a picnic, and eventually becoming a teacher like Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). She also prefers to be called Cordelia.

## History

Anne Shirley, an adopted orphan without family, was taken in at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) after being sent by mistake instead of a boy, though [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) soon decided to keep and raise her. Shortly after arriving, she vowed eternal friendship with [Diana Barry](../character/di.md) in the garden at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope). Her early years at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) were marked by dramatic misadventures, including accidentally getting [Diana](../character/diana.md) drunk on currant wine, falling from a roof and breaking her ankle on a dare, and being forced to cut her hair short after trying to dye her red hair black with peddler's dye. Despite these mishaps, she proved her resourcefulness by saving Diana's baby sister from croup, earned the forgiveness of local adults like Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) and Miss [Josephine Barry](../character/aunt-josephine.md), and excelled academically by joining Miss Stacy's advanced class to prepare for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). [Anne](../character/anne.md) later became a beloved local teacher and led the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society) alongside [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), though she made notable mistakes like selling her neighbor's cow by accident and accidentally staining her nose red with rug dye. She attended [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) with her friends, during which time she rejected marriage proposals from both [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and wealthy [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md) while pursuing her writing ambitions. After graduating and continuing her career as a schoolteacher, she eventually reconciled her feelings for [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). With her college years behind her, [Anne](../character/anne.md) completed her teaching duties and prepared to marry [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) before relocating to [Four Winds Harbor](../codex/places.md#four-winds-harbor).

## Quotes

> "I’ll fold them nicely tonight. They always made us do that at the asylum. Half the time, though, I’d forget, I’d be in such a hurry to get into bed nice and quiet and imagine things."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers P2](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0002)

> "I’d do anything to oblige you. But you’ll have to tell me what to say for this once. After I get into bed I’ll imagine out a real nice prayer to say always. I believe that it will be quite interesting, now that I come to think of it."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers P15](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0015)

> "But I’d be ever so much gratefuller if—if you’d made just one of them with puffed sleeves. Puffed sleeves are so fashionable now. It would give me such a thrill, Marilla, just to wear a dress with puffed sleeves."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school P9](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0009)

> "Oh, Marilla, I’m frightened—now that it has come I’m actually frightened. What if she shouldn’t like me! It would be the most tragical disappointment of my life."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P10](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0010)

> "I’ll just eat one tonight, Marilla. And I can give Diana half of them, can’t I? The other half will taste twice as sweet to me if I give some to her. It’s delightful to think I have something to give her."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P45](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0045)

## Relationships

### [Di](../character/di.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--di.md)

[Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Di](../character/di.md) first met in the garden at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), where they instantly hit it off and solemnly vowed to be best friends forever. Their close friendship and camaraderie have endured through school years, social outings, and major life transitions, such as [Anne](../character/anne.md) leaving for college.

### [Diana](../character/diana.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--diana.md)

[Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) formed an immediate, passionate bond as schoolmates and best chums. Their friendship faced early strain when Diana's mother temporarily banned them from playing together after [Anne](../character/anne.md) accidentally served [Diana](../character/diana.md) wine instead of raspberry cordial, but they reconciled after [Anne](../character/anne.md) saved Diana's sick sister. Throughout their youth, they shared countless adventures, school events, and quiet moments together.

- Friend of — best chums and schoolmates  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--gilbert-blythe.md)

Initially, [Anne](../character/anne.md) held intense contempt and hard feelings toward [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), angrily rejecting his attempt to apologize after he saved her from a sinking dory. Despite her initial hostility, their relationship shifted into an intense academic rivalry as they competed to be top of their class, which later evolved into mutual respect as co-organizers of the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society) and close friends at college. Though [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) eventually proposed, [Anne](../character/anne.md) rejected his romantic advances to remain friends, though they later planned to marry.

### [Jane](../character/jane.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--jane.md)

[Anne](../character/anne.md) and Jane were old friends and classmates who participated in the same local activities, including a creative story club and the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society). ### [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--lynde.md)

By the time [Anne](../character/anne.md) left for [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) gave her a hearty embrace and warm farewell, solidifying their affectionate bond.

### [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--marilla-cuthbert.md)

[Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) initially hesitated to keep [Anne](../character/anne.md) due to a mix-up at the orphanage, but quickly took on the responsibility of raising her. Over time, Marilla's strict discipline gave way to deep love, coming to treasure [Anne](../character/anne.md) like a daughter and supporting her through her schooling, career, and eventual move to start her own life.

[Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) formed an instant, close friendship after meeting on their first day at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) in a cemetery.
